scene.label: Act 1, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Forres. A Room in the Palace.
scene.location: Forres. A Room in the Palace.

content.text: Flourish. Enter Duncan, Malcolm, Donalbain, Lennox and Attendants.

lines.text: Is execution done on Cawdor? Are not
lines.plainText: Is execution done on Cawdor Are not

lines.text: Those in commission yet return'd?
lines.plainText: Those in commission yet return'd

lines.text: My liege,
lines.plainText: My liege

lines.text: They are not yet come back. But I have spoke
lines.plainText: They are not yet come back But I have spoke

lines.text: With one that saw him die, who did report,
lines.plainText: With one that saw him die who did report

lines.text: That very frankly he confess'd his treasons,
lines.plainText: That very frankly he confess'd his treasons

lines.text: Implor'd your Highness' pardon, and set forth
lines.plainText: Implor'd your Highness' pardon and set forth

lines.text: A deep repentance. Nothing in his life
lines.plainText: A deep repentance Nothing in his life

lines.text: Became him like the leaving it; he died
lines.plainText: Became him like the leaving it he died

lines.text: As one that had been studied in his death,
lines.plainText: As one that had been studied in his death

lines.text: To throw away the dearest thing he ow'd
lines.plainText: To throw away the dearest thing he ow'd

lines.text: As 'twere a careless trifle.
lines.plainText: As 'twere a careless trifle

lines.text: There's no art
lines.plainText: There's no art

lines.text: To find the mind's construction in the face:
lines.plainText: To find the mind's construction in the face

lines.text: He was a gentleman on whom I built
lines.plainText: He was a gentleman on whom I built

lines.text: An absolute trust.
lines.plainText: An absolute trust

content.text: Enter Macbeth, Banquo, Ross and Angus.

lines.text: The service and the loyalty I owe,
lines.plainText: The service and the loyalty I owe

lines.text: In doing it, pays itself. Your Highness' part
lines.plainText: In doing it pays itself Your Highness' part

lines.text: Is to receive our duties: and our duties
lines.plainText: Is to receive our duties and our duties

lines.text: Are to your throne and state, children and servants;
lines.plainText: Are to your throne and state children and servants

lines.text: Which do but what they should, by doing everything
lines.plainText: Which do but what they should by doing everything

lines.text: Safe toward your love and honour.
lines.plainText: Safe toward your love and honour

lines.text: Welcome hither:
lines.plainText: Welcome hither

lines.text: I have begun to plant thee, and will labour
lines.plainText: I have begun to plant thee and will labour

lines.text: To make thee full of growing.—Noble Banquo,
lines.plainText: To make thee full of growingNoble Banquo

lines.text: That hast no less deserv'd, nor must be known
lines.plainText: That hast no less deserv'd nor must be known

lines.text: No less to have done so, let me infold thee
lines.plainText: No less to have done so let me infold thee

lines.text: And hold thee to my heart.
lines.plainText: And hold thee to my heart

lines.text: There if I grow,
lines.plainText: There if I grow

lines.text: The harvest is your own.
lines.plainText: The harvest is your own

lines.text: My plenteous joys,
lines.plainText: My plenteous joys

lines.text: Wanton in fulness, seek to hide themselves
lines.plainText: Wanton in fulness seek to hide themselves

lines.text: In drops of sorrow.—Sons, kinsmen, thanes,
lines.plainText: In drops of sorrowSons kinsmen thanes

lines.text: And you whose places are the nearest, know,
lines.plainText: And you whose places are the nearest know

lines.text: We will establish our estate upon
lines.plainText: We will establish our estate upon

lines.text: Our eldest, Malcolm; whom we name hereafter
lines.plainText: Our eldest Malcolm whom we name hereafter

lines.text: The Prince of Cumberland: which honour must
lines.plainText: The Prince of Cumberland which honour must

lines.text: Not unaccompanied invest him only,
lines.plainText: Not unaccompanied invest him only

lines.text: But signs of nobleness, like stars, shall shine
lines.plainText: But signs of nobleness like stars shall shine

lines.text: On all deservers.—From hence to Inverness,
lines.plainText: On all deserversFrom hence to Inverness

lines.text: And bind us further to you.
lines.plainText: And bind us further to you

lines.text: The rest is labour, which is not us'd for you:
lines.plainText: The rest is labour which is not us'd for you

lines.text: I'll be myself the harbinger, and make joyful
lines.plainText: I'll be myself the harbinger and make joyful

lines.text: The hearing of my wife with your approach;
lines.plainText: The hearing of my wife with your approach

lines.text: So, humbly take my leave.
lines.plainText: So humbly take my leave

lines.text: My worthy Cawdor!
lines.plainText: My worthy Cawdor

lines.text: [Aside.] The Prince of Cumberland!—That is a step
lines.plainText: Aside The Prince of CumberlandThat is a step

lines.text: On which I must fall down, or else o'erleap,
lines.plainText: On which I must fall down or else o'erleap

lines.text: For in my way it lies. Stars, hide your fires!
lines.plainText: For in my way it lies Stars hide your fires

lines.text: Let not light see my black and deep desires.
lines.plainText: Let not light see my black and deep desires

lines.text: The eye wink at the hand, yet let that be,
lines.plainText: The eye wink at the hand yet let that be

lines.text: Which the eye fears, when it is done, to see.
lines.plainText: Which the eye fears when it is done to see

lines.text: True, worthy Banquo! He is full so valiant;
lines.plainText: True worthy Banquo He is full so valiant

lines.text: And in his commendations I am fed.
lines.plainText: And in his commendations I am fed

lines.text: It is a banquet to me. Let's after him,
lines.plainText: It is a banquet to me Let's after him

lines.text: Whose care is gone before to bid us welcome:
lines.plainText: Whose care is gone before to bid us welcome

lines.text: It is a peerless kinsman.
lines.plainText: It is a peerless kinsman
